name: dumbbell lying floor skullcrusher
description: A triceps extension lying on the floor, bending only at the elbows. The floor limits the range and keeps tension on the triceps.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop when your upper arms touch the floor lightly.
Extend your elbows to press the weights back up.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and avoid flaring them.
